name: haunt-kit
description: A skeleton for GPS-triggered story walks, with two apps built on it: a Des Moines ghost walk and a party scavenger hunt.
author: Stubborn Otter Software

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/ghost-walk && npm run build -w apps/scavenger-hunt && npm run build -w apps/haunted-house
scripts.build:site: vite build --config site/vite.config.ts && npm run build -w apps/ghost-walk -- --outDir ../../dist/ghost-walk --emptyOutDir && npm run build -w apps/scavenger-hunt -- --outDir ../../dist/spook-hunt --emptyOutDir && npm run build -w apps/haunted-house -- --outDir ../../dist/haunted-house --emptyOutDir
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
